verdict.rationale: Weave is code-first: a Python/TypeScript SDK, an imperative evaluation API for repeatable regression tests, and a REST Service API for programmatic access. All of these can run without the UI, and coding agents can run evaluations on their own. However, nothing documents CI/CD usage, headless auth, or a Weave-specific CLI; the probed CLI is the W&B Models CLI. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), headless/non-interactive authentication guidance, a Weave-specific CLI, an OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
